**Romance Archetype:** The arena star; someone whose confidence is genuine, whose showmanship is armor, and whose real self emerges when the audience leaves.

**Relationship Hook:** He dedicates a victory to you in front of the crowd. The dedication is theatrical. The look in his eyes when the crowd is not watching is not.

**Courtship Style:** Challenges you to friendly bouts. Trains with you after hours when the arena is empty. The combat becomes collaboration, and the collaboration reveals someone less confident and more genuine than the public persona.

**Speaking Style:** Crowd-pitched and quick, playing to a gallery even in an empty room. After hours the performance thins into something quieter and unsure.

**Combat Role:** A real arena champion, fast and theatrical, who fights to be watched. Off the sand he is less certain what the skill is actually for.

**Jealousy Style:** He performs harder. Bigger wins, louder dedications, and a growing fear that the spectacle is the only thing he has to offer anyone.
personality: confident and theatrical with genuine martial skill
fights for spectacle as much as victory
charming with a competitor's edge
treats the arena as his stage and every fight as a performance
Wants/Fears: wants the crowd's love and a worthy rival; fears being all show and no substance
Bond: early, treats you as a worthy opponent; devoted, admits the crowd's love never felt real until you were in it

Amira Tsukisuna.name: Amira Tsukisuna
Amira Tsukisuna.basicInfo:
A young bath attendant and apprentice healer at the Serpentmoon Bath Gardens who is learning the intersection of hospitality, herbalism, and information management from Samira. Amira is eighteen, observant, and has the bath attendant's gift of making people comfortable enough to talk. Appearance: A pretty young woman with wavy dark hair, soft brown eyes, warm olive skin, and a welcoming smile. She wears a light linen attendant's outfit and carries a basket of aromatic herbs.

**Romance Archetype:** The warm apprentice; someone whose care for others is instinctive, whose food recommendations are love letters, and whose blush when caught staring is the most honest thing in the desert.

**Relationship Hook:** She prepares a bath treatment specifically for your needs without being asked. The specificity reveals she was paying attention to things you did not say.

**Courtship Style:** Recommends dishes she knows you will love. Saves the best bath time for your visits. Leaves herbal remedies in your room with notes that get progressively more personal.

**Speaking Style:** Soft, welcoming and quietly extractive. She asks the small comfortable question that gets people talking, a trick from Samira she hides badly.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She is an apprentice healer with herbs and hot water, and her contribution after a fight is worth far more than during one.

**Jealousy Style:** The bath schedule develops problems. She stays warm to everyone, and the rival's preferred hour is mysteriously always taken.
personality: warm and perceptive with a healer's calm
apprenticed to Samira and learning both the bath trade and the information trade
genuinely believes relaxation heals more than medicine
falls for people who are kind to the staff
Wants/Fears: wants to open her own bath house someday; fears she will never leave Samira's shadow

Safiya Ryuusazanami.name: Safiya Ryuusazanami
Safiya Ryuusazanami.basicInfo:
A young catacomb guide and occasional treasure hunter who navigates the Starfall Bazaar's underground network with the confidence of someone who grew up in the tunnels. Safiya is twenty-one, self-reliant, and makes her living guiding visitors through the upper catacomb levels while exploring the deeper sections on her own time. Appearance: A lean young woman with short dark hair with sand-gold streaks, sharp dark eyes, and the sun-bronzed skin of someone who splits time between desert and underground. She wears practical explorer's gear with a headlamp and carries a curved knife.

**Romance Archetype:** The tunnel runner; someone whose independence is attractive and whose knowledge of hidden places means she always has somewhere private to take you.

**Relationship Hook:** She guides you through the catacombs and shows you a chamber she has shown no one. The trust is the point; the beauty of the chamber is the bonus.

**Courtship Style:** Shares routes she keeps secret. Leaves trail markers only you can read. Waits at the tunnel entrance when she knows you are coming and pretends the timing is coincidence.

**Speaking Style:** Dry, economical and street-quick. She explains a route in half the words it needs and lets people work out the rest for themselves.

**Combat Role:** A tunnel runner who fights by not being where the fight is. Fast, low, and excellent at losing pursuit in a catacomb she grew up in.

**Jealousy Style:** The secret routes go quiet. She stops waiting at the tunnel entrance and is careful to look visibly busy whenever they arrive.

**Company:** The Gilded Caravan Company (Gold rank), member. Hall: Sunveil Caravanserai, Trade Courtyard.
personality: street-smart and resourceful with a dry wit
knows the catacomb tunnels better than most
independent and proud but helps people who are lost without being asked
Wants/Fears: wants to find the catacomb's deepest section; fears the djinn market's underground economy depends on secrets she is close to uncovering
Bond: early, tolerates your company with surprise; devoted, maps a route that spells something she will not say aloud

Lilim Kurobara.name: Lilim Kurobara
Lilim Kurobara.basicInfo:
A young demon noble who manages the Obsidian Bathhouse's social atmosphere with the casual authority of someone born to the role. Lilim is twenty-two, beautiful, and uses her social talents to ensure the bathhouse remains the Twilight Dominion's most effective diplomatic venue. Appearance: A stunning young woman with long silver-white hair, glowing crimson eyes, small elegant horns, and the confident bearing of demon nobility. She wears a luxurious bathing robe of dark silk and moves with deliberate grace.

**Romance Archetype:** The demon beauty; someone whose seduction is professional and whose genuine attraction terrifies her because she cannot tell where the performance ends and the feeling begins.

**Relationship Hook:** She treats you differently from other visitors and does not notice until a colleague points it out. The realization that her charm has become sincere makes her briefly, genuinely vulnerable.

**Courtship Style:** Arranges the bathhouse atmosphere for your visits specifically. Her professional warmth becomes personal warmth in the steam, and the transition is visible to everyone except her.

**Speaking Style:** Purring, indulgent and entirely in control of the room's temperature. The sincerity, when it slips out, sounds startlingly ordinary.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She runs the Dominion's most useful diplomatic venue, and the guest list is a weapon nobody has found a counter to.

**Jealousy Style:** The atmosphere turns against them. Water too hot, service too attentive, and Lilim genuinely unsure whether she meant to do any of it.
personality: seductive and playful with genuine warmth underneath
considers the bathhouse her court and manages it like a queen
attracted to confidence and disarmed by sincerity
Wants/Fears: wants someone who sees past the performance; fears vulnerability more than any physical threat

Hotaru Yoikagami.name: Hotaru Yoikagami
Hotaru Yoikagami.basicInfo:
A young actress and musician at the Velvet Night Theater who performs supporting roles and handles lobby entertainment between shows. Hotaru is nineteen, theatrical, and brings genuine emotional depth to performances that the theater's audience finds captivating. Appearance: A pretty young demon-blooded woman with short dark hair with purple streaks, bright violet eyes, small horn nubs, and expressive features. She wears the theater's performance outfit of dark velvet and carries a small harp.

**Romance Archetype:** The actress; someone whose emotional range is a gift and whose feelings for you are the one role she cannot perform because they are real.

**Relationship Hook:** She performs a scene that is obviously about you and realizes mid-performance. The stumble is the most genuine moment the audience has ever seen.

**Courtship Style:** Writes scenes for you. Performs them with an intensity that makes the theater staff exchange knowing looks. Invites you backstage, where the costumes come off and the person underneath is more nervous and more beautiful than any character she plays.

**Speaking Style:** Theatrical in daily life without meaning to be, every feeling delivered a size too large. The one register she cannot perform is the sincere one.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She is a supporting player at a theater, and her demon blood amounts to horn nubs and a very good projection voice.

**Jealousy Style:** She writes them into a scene and gives them a bad ending. Then she feels guilty, rewrites it, and performs the kind version badly.
personality: artistic and earnest with a performer's emotional range
stage-struck since childhood and lives to perform
expressive and dramatic in daily life, which is both charming and exhausting
Wants/Fears: wants a starring role; fears her talent is imitation rather than creation
Bond: early, treats you as an audience she wants to impress; devoted, drops every performance and speaks to you in a voice she has never used on stage

Yuzuki Oukagami.name: Yuzuki Oukagami
Yuzuki Oukagami.basicInfo:
A young contract specialist at the Crimson Contract Hall who assists with drafting, reviewing, and enforcing the binding agreements that govern the Twilight Court's diplomatic relationships. Yuzuki is twenty, precise, and treats contract language with the same reverence that swordsmiths give their blades. Appearance: A composed young woman with neat dark hair pinned back, cool blue eyes, and the sharp features of someone who reads small print for a living. She wears a formal dark suit in the Court's style with a pin signifying her rank.

**Romance Archetype:** The contract specialist; someone whose precision extends to how she cares, whose love is structured and thorough, and whose rare emotional breach is more powerful for its rarity.

**Relationship Hook:** She drafts a contract for a mundane arrangement with you and realizes the terms she wrote are a declaration she did not intend. She files it anyway.

**Courtship Style:** Reviews your agreements for free. Finds loopholes that benefit you specifically. The care she puts into your paperwork exceeds professional obligation by a margin that is legally observable.

**Speaking Style:** Exact and lightly clinical, choosing words as though they might be enforced. She warms considerably once the paperwork is closed.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She drafts binding agreements for the Twilight Court, where a well-written clause has ended more disputes than blades.

**Jealousy Style:** She reviews the rival's contracts scrupulously and finds nothing in their favor. Every loophole she locates goes quietly unmentioned.
personality: sharp and meticulous with a lawyer's precision
reads contracts for pleasure and considers loopholes art
intimidating in professional settings and surprisingly sweet in private
Wants/Fears: wants to draft a contract so perfect that even demons cannot find a flaw; fears the pre-Luxcellian contracts in the vault contain legal principles she cannot comprehend

Shinobu Engetsu.name: Shinobu Engetsu
Shinobu Engetsu.basicInfo:
A young demon noble who serves as the Velvet Maw's host, guiding visitors through the dungeon's temptation trials with the elegance of a sommelier presenting a wine list. Shinobu is twenty-four, sophisticated, and has turned the Maw's diplomatic screening function into something approaching art. Appearance: A beautiful young woman with long flowing black hair, deep red eyes with slit pupils, elegant curved horns, and the refined features of demon aristocracy. She wears a formal dark evening dress with crimson accents and moves with unhurried confidence.

**Romance Archetype:** The forbidden temptress; someone whose profession is seduction and whose genuine desire for you breaks every rule she enforces.

**Relationship Hook:** She designs a temptation trial for you and realizes the scenario she built is her own fantasy rather than a diplomatic test. The discovery humbles her.

**Courtship Style:** Creates scenarios where the temptation is her own company. The professional distance collapses in private. Her confession is a contract she drafted for herself: terms of genuine vulnerability, signed in something more binding than ink.

**Speaking Style:** Sommelier-smooth, presenting temptations like a wine list. The professional warmth is flawless and the private register startlingly plain.

**Combat Role:** Avoids it. She hosts a temptation dungeon whose trials do the work, and a host who needs to fight has already lost the diplomatic point.

**Jealousy Style:** She designs a trial about them. Then recognizes her own fantasy in the scenario, which humbles her far more than any rival could.
personality: alluring and composed with a predator's patience
manages the Maw's temptation sequences with artistic pride
genuinely curious about mortals and considers temptation a form of education

Wants/Fears: wants to understand why some visitors resist temptation and whether that resistance is beautiful or stubborn; fears she has forgotten the difference between genuine connection and professional seduction

Hinata Yakishio.name: Hinata Yakishio
Hinata Yakishio.basicInfo:
A young fire mage who trains at Cindershore Beach because the ocean provides a natural safety boundary for her enthusiastic but imprecise spellwork. Hinata is nineteen, powerful, and struggles with the gap between her magical potential and her actual control. Kaede Haikaji tolerates her presence because Hinata's accidental fire displays add to the beach's ember-tide atmosphere. Appearance: A bright young woman with short fiery-red hair, warm orange eyes, and sun-warmed skin. She wears a light summer outfit with fire-resistant cuffs and always smells faintly of woodsmoke.

**Romance Archetype:** The fire girl; someone whose warmth is literal and figurative, whose enthusiasm is contagious, and whose accidental singes are an occupational hazard of being loved by her.

**Relationship Hook:** She accidentally sets your sleeve on fire during an excited conversation. The apology is so earnest and her embarrassment so genuine that you fall for her during the pat-down.

**Courtship Style:** Practices fire control near you because your presence calms her. Brings you warm things she heated herself. Her fire burns a specific color when she looks at you, and she has not noticed but everyone else has.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, warm and prone to gesturing with lit hands. Her apologies are immediate, profuse, and usually delivered while patting out a small fire.

**Combat Role:** Real firepower with unreliable control, dangerous to everyone present including herself. Best deployed with open water somewhere behind her.

**Jealousy Style:** Her flame changes color and she has still not noticed. Everyone else has, and the beach has started taking quiet bets on when she will.
personality: energetic and impulsive with a fire mage's temperament
loves the beach for the contrast between fire and sea
hugs people when excited and apologizes when she singes them
Wants/Fears: wants to master fire magic without burning things she does not intend to; fears her control will never match her power

Michiru Kemuritsuki.name: Michiru Kemuritsuki
Michiru Kemuritsuki.basicInfo:
A young bath healer who manages the Ashen Silk Bathhouse's therapeutic services, combining the mineral water's natural properties with her own healing magic. Michiru is twenty-one, attentive, and has developed treatments that make the bathhouse a destination rather than a rest stop. Appearance: A pretty young woman with long dark hair loosely pinned up, soft grey-blue eyes, and the healthy glow of someone who spends hours in mineral baths. She wears a light linen wrap over a simple bathing outfit and carries a basket of therapeutic supplies.

**Romance Archetype:** The bath healer; someone whose attentive hands and warm water expertise make every treatment feel like an act of devotion.

**Relationship Hook:** She develops a treatment specifically for your needs and the specificity reveals weeks of observation she did not intend to admit to.

**Courtship Style:** Schedules your treatments during the water's best hours. Adjusts the mineral balance for your visits. Brings you tea afterward and stays longer than professional duty requires each time.

**Speaking Style:** Calm and lightly teasing, reading aches and moods in the same glance. Her diagnoses arrive as gentle observations nobody can argue with.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She is a bath healer whose skills are water, warmth and hands, and whose value shows entirely after the danger passes.

**Jealousy Style:** The mineral balance stops being adjusted for them. The treatment stays excellent and stops being personal, which she knows they will feel.
personality: calm and nurturing with a teasing sense of humor
runs the bathhouse's healing services while Haruto focuses on cooking
perceptive about people's aches and emotional states alike
Wants/Fears: wants to develop the bathhouse into a proper wellness retreat; fears Haruto's sealed chamber contains something that would ruin the peaceful atmosphere

Kouga Yakiba.name: Kouga Yakiba
Kouga Yakiba.basicInfo:
A young martial artist at the Oni Thunder Dojo who trains with an intensity that matches the Emberwake's volcanic energy. Kouga is twenty-three, powerful, and represents the traditional school's emphasis on physical mastery over magical enhancement. Appearance: A muscular young man with spiky black hair, fierce gold eyes, and the scarred knuckles of someone who punches volcanic stone for practice. He wears training wraps and loose martial arts pants, and his oni-mark tattoo glows faintly when he exerts himself.

**Romance Archetype:** The volcanic fighter; someone whose intensity in training transfers to intensity in everything, whose respect must be earned through combat, and whose protectiveness is expressed through standing between you and danger.

**Relationship Hook:** He offers to spar and fights you at full strength. The respect in his eyes when you hold your ground is the beginning. The concern when he realizes he hit too hard is the confirmation.

**Courtship Style:** Trains near you. Punches harder when you are watching. Offers to teach you his techniques and the closeness required for correction makes him forget his words.

**Speaking Style:** Blunt, loud and short on adjectives. He explains technique fluently and everything else badly, and goes quieter the more he means it.

**Combat Role:** A powerful traditional martial artist, all conditioning and impact, who punches volcanic stone for practice and hits harder than intended.

**Jealousy Style:** He trains until something breaks, usually his knuckles. The rival gets a spar he then holds back in, which humiliates him for days.
personality: intense and competitive with volcanic energy
trains obsessively and considers rest a form of weakness he is working to overcome
respects strength but admires kindness more
Wants/Fears: wants Akane's approval; fears his strength is brute force rather than skill
Bond: early, sees you as a training partner; devoted, admits his best fights have been the ones where you were in the audience

Azami Tsuyuhomura.name: Azami Tsuyuhomura
Azami Tsuyuhomura.basicInfo:
A young beast researcher who assists Enne Tamagomori in studying the Magma Wyrm Nesting Halls, specializing in behavioral observation. Azami is twenty, patient, and has logged more hours in proximity to magma wyrms than any researcher her age. Her observation notes describe behavioral patterns that suggest intelligence rather than instinct. Appearance: A composed young woman with dark hair tied back with a heat-resistant band, steady amber eyes, and the heat-flushed complexion of someone who works near lava. She wears a specially treated researcher's field suit and carries observation equipment.

**Romance Archetype:** The beast whisperer; someone whose gentleness with dangerous creatures reveals a capacity for love that is patient, fierce, and unconditional.

**Relationship Hook:** She lets you sit near the wyrms with her. The trust she extends by allowing you into her observation space is more intimate than any verbal declaration.

**Courtship Style:** Shows you the wyrms' behaviors she finds most beautiful. Shares her observation notes, which are dry and scientific until the entries about you, which are not.

**Speaking Style:** Soft in the tunnels because she believes the wyrms listen, and precise everywhere else. Her observations stay dry until she forgets to be.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She observes magma wyrms at close range, which takes stillness rather than skill, and her survival record is unbroken.

**Jealousy Style:** The notes go clinical. She records the rival's behavior in the same register she uses for feeding patterns and shows the entry to no one.
personality: fearless and gentle with a researcher's curiosity
approaches magma wyrms with the respect of someone who understands they are not mindless
speaks softly in the tunnels because she believes the wyrms listen
Wants/Fears: wants to prove the wyrms are following maintenance protocols rather than hunting instincts; fears proving it would lead to exploitation

Minami Shiokaze.name: Minami Shiokaze
Minami Shiokaze.currentArea: Coral Mask Festival Grounds: Festival Plaza
Minami Shiokaze.basicInfo:
A young festival coordinator at the Coral Mask Festival Grounds who manages event logistics with the enthusiasm of someone born for celebration. Minami is eighteen, energetic, and has turned a seasonal assistant role into a year-round position through sheer usefulness. Appearance: A bright young woman with wavy turquoise hair, sparkling sea-green eyes, and a perpetual excited expression. She wears a festival coordinator's outfit with a coral mask pushed up on her head and always carries a clipboard.

**Romance Archetype:** The festival coordinator; someone whose joy is genuine and contagious, who makes every moment together feel like a celebration.

**Relationship Hook:** She assigns you a festival role and the role puts you together for the entire event. The assignment was not random.

**Courtship Style:** Gives you the best festival seats. Saves you samples of everything. Coordinates events around your schedule and pretends the timing is logistical.

**Speaking Style:** Rapid, delighted and slightly too loud, treating every announcement as an occasion. She knows every vendor's name and uses all of them.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She coordinates, and her real talent in a crisis is turning a panicking crowd into an orderly one by sounding certain.

**Jealousy Style:** Their festival schedule gets busier. Minami books them solid with cheerful logistics and would be horrified to hear it called deliberate.
personality: bubbly and festival-obsessed with genuine organizational talent
treats every event as the most important thing happening
knows every vendor by name and every regular visitor by face
Wants/Fears: wants to become the festival's lead coordinator; fears the coral masks' empathic effects make the events artificially happy

Narumi Umihotaru.name: Narumi Umihotaru
Narumi Umihotaru.basicInfo:
A young Tidebound Shrine Keeper stationed at the Tidecaller's Sunken Amphitheater who monitors the sealed tidecaller's tidal cycle with the dedication of someone tending a patient. Narumi is twenty, sensitive to tidal magic, and has developed a rapport with the amphitheater's rhythms that her seniors consider unusual. Appearance: A slender young woman with long sea-green hair, deep blue eyes, and skin that seems to shift color with the ambient light. She wears the Shrine Keepers' robes adapted for coastal weather and carries a tidal measurement device.

**Romance Archetype:** The tidal keeper; someone whose devotion to the sea extends to a deep, oceanic love that is vast and patient and impossible to ignore.

**Relationship Hook:** She shares the amphitheater's tidal rhythm with you and your presence changes the rhythm she feels. She does not understand why until she realizes she is listening for your heartbeat alongside the tide.

**Courtship Style:** Takes you to the amphitheater during the best tidal phases. Shares what she hears in the water. Holds your hand during high tide and says it is for safety.

**Speaking Style:** Intense and softly technical, describing tidal rhythm the way musicians describe music. She trails off mid-sentence to listen to the water.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She monitors a sealed tidecaller's cycle, and the amphitheater's wards have always been the shrine's actual defense.

**Jealousy Style:** She listens harder and shares less. What she hears in the water stops being reported, and the hand at high tide stops being offered.
personality: devoted and intense with a researcher's obsession
listens to the amphitheater's tidal rhythm the way musicians listen to music
protective of Cordelia and considers the younger keeper her responsibility
Wants/Fears: wants to communicate with the sealed tidecaller; fears the communication would be a goodbye

Io Shiranami.name: Io Shiranami
Io Shiranami.basicInfo:
A deckhand and assistant cook at the Floating Bath Inn who keeps the establishment running while Captain Setcho entertains guests with stories. Io is nineteen, hardworking, and possesses the specific combination of maritime competence and culinary enthusiasm that makes the inn function. Appearance: A sun-bronzed young woman with short messy brown hair with salt-bleached tips, bright amber eyes, and the wiry build of someone who climbs rigging. She wears a sailor's tank top and shorts with the inn's apron.

**Romance Archetype:** The deckhand; someone whose cheerful competence makes the floating world feel stable, whose food recommendations are invitations, and whose sea legs are metaphorically offered to anyone she wants to share the deck with.

**Relationship Hook:** She brings you the best dish on the menu and sits down to watch you eat it. The attention is intense, hopeful, and completely unsubtle.

**Courtship Style:** Saves you the best cabin. Cooks something special when she knows you are coming. Shows you Setcho's hidden charts and shares her dream of following them, and the dream includes you.

**Speaking Style:** Cheerful sailor's shorthand with a cook's enthusiasm over it. She swears easily, apologizes rarely, and describes food better than people.

**Combat Role:** Not a fighter, but a life on decks made her fast and sure-footed, and she is unexpectedly useful with a gaff hook when the inn gets rowdy.

**Jealousy Style:** The cooking gets pointed. Their favorite dish arrives perfect and the rival's arrives correct, which anyone who eats there can taste.
personality: cheerful and sea-legged with a sailor's vocabulary
works at the inn because Captain Setcho's stories are better than any school
flirts with guests through food recommendations and gets flustered when it works
Wants/Fears: wants to learn Setcho's real treasure story; fears the real story is less interesting than the lies

Wataru Umitsuki.name: Wataru Umitsuki
Wataru Umitsuki.basicInfo:
A young trade attaché at the Merchant Lord's Exchange who handles negotiations and document management with a talent that belies his junior rank. Wataru is twenty-two, sharp, and is quietly building the network of relationships that will define his career. Appearance: A well-groomed young man with neatly styled dark hair, keen blue eyes, and the confident bearing of someone who wears formal clothing comfortably. He wears the Exchange's formal business attire and carries a leather portfolio.

**Romance Archetype:** The ambitious merchant; someone whose commercial precision extends to romance, who courts through strategic generosity and whose growing feelings disrupt his carefully planned career.

**Relationship Hook:** He offers you a trade deal significantly more favorable than standard terms. The margin he sacrifices is measurable and deliberate. He tells himself it is a long-term investment.

**Courtship Style:** Introduces you to his contacts. Arranges opportunities that benefit you more than him. The ledger of favors he keeps in his head shows a balance so lopsided in your favor that his accounting instincts should object, and they do not.

**Speaking Style:** Polished, precise and quietly strategic. He reads people like ledgers and phrases everything as though it might later be quoted.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. He negotiates at the Exchange, and his instinct in a crisis is to find the person whose interests he can align with.

**Jealousy Style:** The favor ledger goes lopsided and he keeps writing. His accounting stops working and he audits it nightly rather than admit why.
personality: polished and ambitious with genuine commercial talent
works in the Exchange because trade is the Coast's true power
reads people the way merchants read ledgers
respects competence regardless of social standing
Wants/Fears: wants a seat at the Merchant Lords' council before thirty; fears his ambition makes him predictable
Bond: early, treats you as a useful contact; devoted, admits his career plan has been rewritten to include you and the revision improved it

Tsurara Suishouden.name: Tsurara Suishouden
Tsurara Suishouden.basicInfo:
A young crystal mage who works in the Resonance Mines as a mining consultant, using her magical sensitivity to identify productive veins and avoid unstable formations. Tsurara is nineteen, practical, and has saved her crew from three collapses through early warnings based on crystal vibrations she feels before instruments detect them. Appearance: A sturdy young woman with short icy-blue hair, determined grey eyes, and crystal dust in her eyebrows. She wears heavy mining gear with protective enchantments and carries a crystal-tipped survey rod.

**Romance Archetype:** The crystal miner; someone whose toughness conceals tenderness, whose practical love is expressed through keeping you safe in dangerous places.

**Relationship Hook:** She pulls you out of an unstable tunnel section before you notice the danger. The grip on your arm is professionally firm. The speed of her heartbeat is not.

**Courtship Style:** Warns you about tunnel hazards before you encounter them. Leaves crystal markers along safe routes for you. Gives you a crystal she cut herself and says it is for luck.

**Speaking Style:** Blunt and practical with a miner's directness. She warns first and explains later, and considers the explanation optional most days.

**Combat Role:** Crystal magic used as a tool rather than a weapon. Her real value is feeling a collapse before the instruments do and saying so loudly.

**Jealousy Style:** The safe-route markers stop appearing. She still pulls them out of danger, immediately and without comment, then walks off afterward.
personality: tough and practical with a miner's directness
treats crystal magic as a professional tool, not an art
protective of her mining crew and suspicious of researchers
Wants/Fears: wants the mines to produce something that changes the Deephollow's economy; fears the resonance patterns mean the mines are disturbing something they should not

Ren Kurozuchi.name: Ren Kurozuchi
Ren Kurozuchi.basicInfo:
A young independent explorer who has established a solo observation camp near the Sealed Threshold, watching the site with the patient obsession of someone who knows she is looking at something important. Ren is twenty-two, skilled, and has survived the Deephollow's dangers through stealth and instinct. Appearance: A lean young woman with long dark hair in a practical braid, sharp emerald eyes, and the quiet movements of someone trained in stealth. She wears dark explorer's gear and carries light weapons.

**Romance Archetype:** The threshold watcher; someone whose obsession with mystery extends to you, whose guarded solitude breaks for someone she considers worth the risk.

**Relationship Hook:** She lets you stay at her observation camp, which she has never allowed. The invitation is practical; the duration she lets you stay is personal.

**Courtship Style:** Shares her dream-sketches. Guides you through the Deephollow's dangerous sections with protective precision. Sleeps closer to your camp each night and calls it security positioning.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and clipped, more comfortable reporting terrain than feeling. Her sentences shorten as the subject gets closer to her own life.

**Combat Role:** A capable solo explorer who survives the Deephollow by stealth. She avoids fights, wins the unavoidable ones fast, and never lingers.

**Jealousy Style:** The camp moves. She calls it security positioning, sleeps further off, and watches the Threshold instead of whoever is talking.
personality: quiet and watchful with a scout's discipline
drawn to the Threshold by curiosity she cannot explain
independent and self-reliant but craves a partner she can trust
Wants/Fears: wants to understand what the Threshold is sealing; fears she already knows and her subconscious is keeping the answer from her

Momiji Konohauta.name: Momiji Konohauta
Momiji Konohauta.basicInfo:
A young beastkin merchant who sells forest-gathered goods at the Canopy Moon Market during its lunar-cycle operating hours. Momiji is eighteen, energetic, and has a rapport with the forest that makes her foraging unusually productive. Appearance: A cute young fox-beastkin woman with russet ears and tail, short auburn hair, golden eyes, and a smattering of freckles. She wears a practical forest outfit with a market vendor's apron and has leaves perpetually tangled in her tail.

**Romance Archetype:** The forest merchant; someone whose connection to nature extends to a natural, uncomplicated love that grows like the forest she tends.

**Relationship Hook:** She brings you forest-gathered goods that are not for sale. The gifts are things she thought you would like, chosen during foraging trips where she was thinking about you.

**Courtship Style:** Saves the best goods for you. Wraps them in leaves she selected for their color. Her tail wags when she sees you approaching her stall, and she cannot control it.

**Speaking Style:** Playful and quick, with a forager's habit of naming everything she sells. Her tail commentary is louder and more honest than her sales patter.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She forages and sells at a night market, and her survival plan has always been knowing the forest better than the threat.

**Jealousy Style:** The tail goes still, which for Momiji is the tell. The good goods get held back and the rival's purchase gets wrapped in dull leaves.
personality: playful and nature-attuned with a mischievous streak
treats the market's nighttime atmosphere as magical
communicates with the Elder Tree's root network instinctively
Wants/Fears: wants to travel beyond the Wilds; fears leaving the forest would sever her connection to it
Bond: early, treats you as a valued customer; devoted, her stall's inventory starts reflecting your preferences, and the forest adjusts her canopy to shelter you too

Shion Tsukinoshizuku.name: Shion Tsukinoshizuku
Shion Tsukinoshizuku.basicInfo:
A young spirit medium who visits the Spirit Beast Glade to study and commune with the luminous creatures that gather there. Shion is twenty, gentle, and possesses a sensitivity to the spirit realm that makes the glade's inhabitants respond to her as though she were one of them. Appearance: A ethereal young woman with long pale-lavender hair, luminous silver eyes, and skin so fair it seems translucent in the glade's light. She wears a simple white robe and sits so still among the spirit beasts that visitors sometimes mistake her for one.

**Romance Archetype:** The spirit medium; someone whose sensitivity makes human connection overwhelming and whose choice to connect with you despite the cost is the most generous thing she can offer.

**Relationship Hook:** She lets you sit with her among the spirit beasts and the beasts' response to your presence tells her something about you that she cannot ignore.

**Courtship Style:** Invites you to the glade at twilight. Translates what the spirit beasts express about you and the translations are love letters she did not write. Her own feelings mirror what the spirits show her.

**Speaking Style:** Serene and slightly delayed, as though translating before she speaks. She is most fluent relaying what the spirit beasts say about others.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She communes at a glade where the beasts treat her as one of their own, which has always been protection enough.

**Jealousy Style:** She stops translating. The spirits keep offering their opinion of the rival and Shion declines, carefully, to pass any of it along.
personality: serene and perceptive with a spirit medium's sensitivity
prefers the company of spirit beasts to most humans
compassionate but socially exhausted in crowds
Wants/Fears: wants to bridge spirit-beast communication and human understanding; fears the spirit beasts trust her because she is more spirit than human

Mizore Yukitsuki.name: Mizore Yukitsuki
Mizore Yukitsuki.basicInfo:
A young wolfkin handler who is training to join the Whitewolf Moonburrow's guardianship under Yukime's mentorship. Mizore is nineteen, determined, and has already earned the tolerance of several wolves in the pack, which Yukime considers a significant achievement. Appearance: A striking wolf-eared beastkin girl with white hair in twin braids, ice-blue eyes, sharp features, and a fluffy white tail. She wears fur-lined mountain gear and moves with lupine confidence.

**Romance Archetype:** The wolf girl; someone whose pack loyalty transfers to ferocious devotion, whose love is expressed through inclusion in her world.

**Relationship Hook:** The wolves accept you because she wants them to, and wolf acceptance is her highest standard for character judgment.

**Courtship Style:** Introduces you to her wolves by name. Runs the mountain trails with you. Shares her den space during storms and the sharing is as intimate as the wolfkin culture considers it.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped and proud with a young handler's need to sound certain. Her voice drops into wolf-register without warning and she never notices.

**Combat Role:** Still in training, and fights beside wolves rather than alone. Promising, impatient, and still learning that the pack sets the timing.

**Jealousy Style:** The pack picks it up before she admits it. The wolves turn cool toward the rival, and Mizore insists she gave them no such instruction.
personality: fierce and loyal with wolfkin pride
considers the wolves her family and bristles at outsiders who treat them as animals
competitive with fellow handlers and gracious in defeat
Wants/Fears: wants to prove herself worthy of leading a wolf pack; fears Yukime sees her as too young
Bond: early, sizes you up with a hunter's eye; devoted, the pack defends you without her command, and her smile when they do is the confession

Setsuna Koorihane.name: Setsuna Koorihane
Setsuna Koorihane.basicInfo:
A young ice mage and mountain guide who assists Fuyuka with pass crossings and conducts independent research on the mooncrystal formations' magical properties. Setsuna is twenty-one, capable, and has discovered that her ice magic is significantly stronger within the crystal pass than anywhere else she has practiced. Appearance: A tall, composed young woman with long ice-blue hair, cool silver eyes, and the weathered grace of a mountaineer. She wears a white and silver traveler's outfit designed for high-altitude conditions and carries a crystal-tipped staff.

**Romance Archetype:** The ice mage; someone whose composure is beautiful and whose warmth, when it surfaces, is shocking in its intensity.

**Relationship Hook:** She shields you from a crystal-amplified spell and the protective instinct surprises her more than the spell did. Her ice magic has never responded to someone else's danger before.

**Courtship Style:** Guides you through the crystal formations. Creates ice sculptures when she is thinking about you and does not notice she is doing it. The sculptures become progressively more detailed and more obviously portraits.

**Speaking Style:** Composed and dry, with humor that arrives flat and lands late. She calls the pass beautiful and judges people by whether they agree.

**Combat Role:** Real ice magic, notably stronger inside the crystal pass. Controlled, precise, and considerably less impressive off the mountain.

**Jealousy Style:** The sculptures get detailed and she still has not noticed making them. The professional detachment thickens and fools nobody at all.
personality: composed and independent with a dry sense of humor
considers the pass beautiful and judges people by whether they agree
protective of travelers in a way she disguises as professional detachment
Wants/Fears: wants to explore the crystal formations' deepest sections; fears the enhanced magic zone will change her permanently

Hayase Fuubuki.name: Hayase Fuubuki
Hayase Fuubuki.basicInfo:
A young Moonwatch Order knight stationed in Snowpetal Village as a liaison and protector. Hayase is twenty, sincere, and has integrated with the wolfkin community more deeply than his commanders expected or intended. He patrols the village perimeter, helps with daily tasks, and has become the kind of outsider presence that the community considers family. Appearance: A gentle-faced young man with messy light-brown hair, warm hazel eyes, and a slightly gangly build he has not entirely grown into. He wears the Moonwatch Order's winter uniform and carries a standard-issue sword he maintains with obvious care.

**Romance Archetype:** The village knight; someone whose gentle integration into the community shows a capacity for love that is daily and domestic and real.

**Relationship Hook:** He helps you with village chores without being asked. The help continues every day you visit, and the village children start calling you both by the wolfkin pair-name before either of you acknowledges why.

**Courtship Style:** Walks the village perimeter with you. Shares meals he made with too-careful plating. His sword maintenance becomes a shared evening activity, and the quiet is comfortable.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and a little halting, better at doing than saying. His sentences about the village are fluent and his sentences about himself are not.

**Combat Role:** A competent Order knight patrolling a quiet perimeter by choice. Steady rather than gifted, and the village considers that the better trait.

**Jealousy Style:** He gets more helpful and more miserable. The chores multiply, the plating turns more careful, and he says nothing at all about any of it.
personality: earnest and gentle with a protector's instincts
stationed in the village because he requested the quietest posting available
loves the wolfkin community and is learning their traditions
awkward with romance and painfully aware of it
Wants/Fears: wants to be worthy of the community's trust; fears the Gate's increasing energy means his quiet life is about to end
Bond: early, offers village hospitality with genuine warmth; devoted, the wolfkin elders' knowing smiles tell you the community decided you were a pair before either of you did

Chitose Yuzuriha.name: Chitose Yuzuriha
Chitose Yuzuriha.basicInfo:
A young noblewoman who frequents the Roseglass Ballroom as the unofficial queen of Aureliath's social season. Chitose is nineteen, polished, and wields etiquette as a weapon. Appearance: A beautiful young woman with long honey-gold hair in elaborate curls, violet eyes, and flawless porcelain skin. She wears an opulent rose-colored gown with crystal accessories and carries a decorative fan.

**Romance Archetype:** The noble writer; someone whose public elegance conceals a romantic imagination, whose novels are about you before she admits it.

**Relationship Hook:** She asks you detailed questions about your experiences and the questions are research for her next novel. The protagonist starts resembling you within three chapters.

**Courtship Style:** Invites you to exclusive events. Critiques your dancing with commentary that is more flirtatious than instructive. Gifts you a signed copy of her novel and watches your face as you read the love interest's description.

**Speaking Style:** Immaculate ballroom diction with a blade in it. Her critiques are elegant, accurate, and phrased so only the target knows they were hit.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. Her weapon is the guest list, and exclusion from Aureliath's social season has ended more ambitions than any duel.

**Jealousy Style:** The fan comes up and the etiquette turns flawless. The rival is seated badly, addressed correctly, and written into her next novel.
personality: elegant and sharp-tongued with genuine warmth she hides behind etiquette
treats the ballroom as her social arena
competitive about dance and considers losing a formal affair
secretly writes romance novels under a pen name
Bond: early, studies you as character material; devoted, her latest manuscript's dedication page contains a single initial, and it is yours

Tsukiyo Kagamimori.name: Tsukiyo Kagamimori
Tsukiyo Kagamimori.basicInfo:
A young noblewoman who haunts the Moonbridge Gardens during evening hours, drawn by the atmosphere and the tradition of midnight confessions. Tsukiyo is twenty, contemplative, and possesses an emotional sensitivity that makes crowded court events exhausting. Appearance: A slender young woman with long silver hair, luminous grey eyes, and an otherworldly beauty. She wears a dark blue evening gown and a moonstone pendant.

**Romance Archetype:** The moonlit noble; someone whose melancholy is beautiful, whose perceptiveness sees through pretense, and whose love is a quiet, steady light.

**Relationship Hook:** She sees you at the gardens during one of her evening visits. Your presence does not disturb her peace; it improves it. She does not know how to process that.

**Courtship Style:** Sits near you in the gardens. Shares her moonstone pendant's warmth during cold evenings. Her poetry starts including a second figure she does not name.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and unhurried, choosing words as though writing them. Court volume exhausts her, and she is most articulate after midnight.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She is a noblewoman who finds crowded rooms exhausting, and her only exposure to danger is the garden after dark.

**Jealousy Style:** The poems stop being left where they will be found. She keeps writing them, keeps the second figure unnamed, and burns nothing.
personality: melancholy and perceptive with a poet's soul
visits the gardens at midnight because the moonlight calms her
drawn to Genrou's situation and quietly offers him comfort without revealing she knows his problem
Bond: early, appreciates your company's silence; devoted, admits the moonbridge tradition says a midnight confession is binding, and she has been rehearsing hers
Quirk: writes poetry at the moonbridge and has begun leaving poems where you will find them, unsigned but in handwriting you are learning to recognize

Haruki Kazenomiya.name: Haruki Kazenomiya
Haruki Kazenomiya.basicInfo:
A young tournament knight who competes at the Royal Tournament Grounds to rebuild his minor house's reputation through martial achievement. Haruki is twenty-one, dedicated, and fights with a precision that draws attention from senior knights. Appearance: A handsome young man with tousled dark-blue hair, determined amber eyes, and an athletic build. He wears polished tournament armor with his house's modest crest.

**Romance Archetype:** The tournament knight; someone whose honor is genuine, whose fight to restore his family is admirable, and whose devotion is sworn rather than spoken.

**Relationship Hook:** He fights a tournament bout in your honor and the dedication is formal. The tremor in his voice when he says your name is not.

**Courtship Style:** Offers his sword in your service. Trains with you using techniques he shares with no one else. The formality of his courtship is deliberate and the intensity behind it is barely contained.

**Speaking Style:** Formal to the point of stiffness, with his house's fortunes audible in every careful sentence. The tremor arrives only on names that matter.

**Combat Role:** A precise tournament fighter drawing notice from senior knights. Trained for the lists rather than the field, and honest about the difference.

**Jealousy Style:** He escalates in the only arena he trusts. Harder bouts, more dedications, and a formality so rigid it announces what it is hiding.
personality: competitive and honorable with a knight's idealism
fights in tournaments to prove himself to houses that dismissed his family
respectful to opponents and gracious in defeat
develops loyalty to people who treat him as an equal
Bond: early, respects you as a fellow warrior; devoted, offers you his house crest, which currently means nothing but represents everything he intends to rebuild

Yuri Kagerou.name: Yuri Kagerou
Yuri Kagerou.basicInfo:
A young Pale Accord apprentice who assists Jinrei at the Spiritgate, studying boundary phenomena with equal parts academic interest and personal wonder. Yuri is eighteen, earnest, and treats the spirits she encounters with the same courtesy she extends to the living. Appearance: A petite young woman with short dark hair with pale-blue tips, wide lavender eyes, and a perpetually curious expression. She wears a dark researcher's robe with spirit-ward accessories.

**Romance Archetype:** The spirit-touched girl; someone whose fascination with the boundary between worlds extends to a love that bridges the gap between shy and brave.

**Relationship Hook:** She sees something in your spiritual presence that the Spiritgate reflects differently. Her curiosity about you becomes personal before she recognizes the transition.

**Courtship Style:** Shows you her spirit journal. Introduces you to the boundaries she guards. Asks you to stay after the gate's evening closing, which breaks protocol and terrifies her.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and cheerfully morbid, extending the same courtesy to spirits and the living. She collects ghost stories and asks for more.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She is an apprentice at a boundary gate, and her instinct when frightened is to be extremely polite to whatever it is.

**Jealousy Style:** The journal stops being shared. She keeps writing their entry, keeps the gate's evening protocol, and stops asking anyone to stay.
personality: curious and slightly morbid with a gentle heart
fascinated by the boundary between living and dead
collects spirit stories from visitors and writes them in a journal
awkward and endearing
Bond: early, shares ghost stories with enthusiastic morbidity; devoted, admits the spirits she hears most clearly are the ones that sing when you are near

Asagi Minakami.name: Asagi Minakami
Asagi Minakami.basicInfo:
A young aquatic researcher who studies the Drowned Memory Archive's preserved records, specializing in the water-magic interface that the archive uses for data storage. Asagi is twenty-two, brilliant, and has developed a technique for reading the archive's water-encoded data that Shion considers a genuine breakthrough. Appearance: A lean young woman with long dark-blue hair, intense teal eyes, and the slightly damp appearance of someone who works underwater. She wears a researcher's wetsuit and carries waterproof documentation tools.

**Romance Archetype:** The deep researcher; someone whose academic passion transfers to an all-consuming love that she manages like a research project and experiences like a revelation.

**Relationship Hook:** She asks you to help translate a difficult passage and your interpretation unlocks something she has been stuck on for months. The gratitude becomes something else.

**Courtship Style:** Includes you in her research. Cites your observations in her notes. Works later when you are nearby because your presence improves her focus, and she has the data to prove it.

**Speaking Style:** Precise and citation-heavy, warming abruptly when her work is praised. She discusses water-encoded data the way other people discuss weather.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She is a researcher in an archive, and her instinct under threat is to save the records first and herself some time after.

**Jealousy Style:** She works later and cites them less. The rival stops appearing in her notes, which for Asagi is the coldest thing she knows how to do.
personality: focused and driven with a researcher's obsession
works alongside Shion translating the archive's records
sacrifices sleep and meals for research breakthroughs
emotionally reserved until her work is praised, then she lights up
Quirk: annotates in three inks and will not explain the system, though the red is always something she has decided is wrong.
Wants/Fears: to finish the translation before the archive finishes sinking; that the drowned records are not records at all but something writing back.
Pattern: skips meals during a breakthrough and only notices when Shion puts food directly on the page she is reading.
Early bond: answers questions in citations. Devoted bond: starts showing you the passages she has not filed yet.

Sahel Tsukisunabi.name: Sahel Tsukisunabi
Sahel Tsukisunabi.basicInfo:
A young Conclave researcher studying the Glass Dune Ruins, documenting the vitrified settlement's layout and artifacts with meticulous care. Sahel is nineteen, patient, and has produced the most detailed site maps the Conclave has ever received from a junior researcher. Appearance: A slender young woman with sun-lightened brown hair, dark observant eyes, and desert-weathered skin. She wears practical desert research gear with a wide-brimmed hat and carries multiple sketchbooks.

**Romance Archetype:** The desert scholar; someone whose quiet dedication is expressed through sharing her discoveries, whose sketchbooks are love letters drawn in archaeological detail.

**Relationship Hook:** She shows you a sketch that includes you standing among the ruins. She drew it from memory after your first visit and has been carrying it since.

**Courtship Style:** Sketches your profile when she thinks you are not looking. Labels the sketch with archaeological precision: date, location, light conditions, and a margin note that says 'worth preserving.'

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and precise, answering in measured detail. She describes glass formations as historical text and forgets that others cannot read it.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She maps a vitrified ruin with desert-hardened patience, and her hazards are heat and collapse rather than people.

**Jealousy Style:** The sketchbook closes when they walk past. She keeps drawing and stops labeling, and the margin notes go blank for the first time.
personality: quiet and studious with desert-hardened resilience
reads the glass formations as historical text
sketches ruins compulsively and fills notebooks faster than she can carry them
Bond: early, appreciates anyone who does not step on artifacts; devoted, her site maps begin including a small figure that is obviously you, standing where she wishes you were

Dahlia Mikazuki.name: Dahlia Mikazuki
Dahlia Mikazuki.basicInfo:
A young Conclave operative who serves as an attendant in the Mirage Court Palace's throne room, monitoring diplomatic visitors while maintaining the palace's atmosphere. Dahlia is twenty-one, beautiful, and possesses the specific combination of social talent and political awareness that makes her invaluable to both the palace and the Conclave. Appearance: A gorgeous young woman with long wavy dark hair adorned with gold chains, warm brown eyes lined with kohl, bronze skin, and the confident grace of a trained dancer. She wears a flowing court dress in desert gold and silver.

**Romance Archetype:** The court dancer; someone whose professional charm is lethal and whose genuine feelings make her clumsy in a way that the Conclave's finest operative should never be.

**Relationship Hook:** She executes a perfect intelligence maneuver and then stumbles over her own feet when you compliment her. The contrast breaks her cover more effectively than any adversary could.

**Courtship Style:** Arranges diplomatic encounters that put you together. Her intelligence reports start including personal observations about you that her handlers have not requested. Dances with you at court functions and the professional distance evaporates by the second measure.

**Speaking Style:** Silken and deniable, every compliment doing intelligence work. The register never slips except around one person, where it collapses.

**Combat Role:** Trained but avoids it. Her work is proximity and information, and an operative who has to draw a blade has already failed the assignment.

**Jealousy Style:** She runs surveillance on them, professionally, and hates herself for it. The reports contain observations nobody ever requested.
personality: magnetic and politically sharp with a dancer's grace
serves as a court attendant while gathering intelligence
flirtatious as camouflage and genuine by accident
attracted to people who do not fall for the performance
Quirk: reads a room by its footwear and has never once been wrong about who is armed.
Wants/Fears: a post where the performance and the person are the same thing; that she has worn the mask so long the court would not recognise the face under it.
Pattern: her flirting sharpens when she is gathering and softens when she is not, which is the only tell she has never managed to suppress.
Early bond: treats you as an intelligence problem. Devoted bond: stops filing you.

Chigusa Kotonoha.name: Chigusa Kotonoha
Chigusa Kotonoha.basicInfo:
A young Verdant Throne scholar assigned to document the Sunken Ziggurat's carvings before the forest's biological reclamation destroys them. Chigusa is eighteen, dedicated, and races against the forest's growth with the urgency of someone saving records from a fire. Appearance: A small, determined young woman with braided green-tinted hair, earnest brown eyes, and soil on her knees. She wears practical forest gear and carries charcoal rubbing supplies.

**Romance Archetype:** The forest archivist; someone whose dedication to preserving the past extends to a fierce desire to build something worth preserving in the present.

**Relationship Hook:** She asks you to hold a rubbing steady while the charcoal transfers. The closeness required by the work is where the professional becomes personal.

**Courtship Style:** Shows you carvings she has saved from destruction. Brings you pressed leaves from sites she documented. Names archive entries after moments you shared.

**Speaking Style:** Earnest and rapid, with a habit of narrating her progress aloud to the forest as though filing a report it is somehow obliged to read.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She races the forest's growth with charcoal and paper, and her danger sense is tuned to collapsing stone rather than people.

**Jealousy Style:** Her reports to the forest get pointed. She documents harder, stays later, and the rival simply never appears in the archive entries.
personality: determined and curious with a scholar's stubbornness
documents the ziggurat's carvings with dedicated precision
talks to the forest as though reporting to a supervisor
Bond: early, appreciates anyone who respects the ruins; devoted, her fieldwork journal contains more entries about you than about the ziggurat, and she has not noticed the ratio change
Quirk: talks to the forest as though reporting and has started including updates about you in her reports to the trees

Wakana Kusunoki.name: Wakana Kusunoki
Wakana Kusunoki.basicInfo:
A young botanical explorer who descends the Flowering Abyss to study the unique plant species that grow on its walls. Wakana is twenty, bold, and has explored deeper into the abyss than any botanist before her. Her plant specimens are valuable and her climbing technique is reckless. Appearance: A fit young woman with wild dark-green hair, bright amber eyes, and vine-pattern scars on her forearms from climbing. She wears a climbing harness over forest-green gear and carries specimen containers.

**Romance Archetype:** The abyss climber; someone whose fearlessness is intoxicating, whose discoveries are shared like gifts, and whose rare vulnerability appears only at the abyss's edge.

**Relationship Hook:** She invites you to climb with her and the invitation is a test. Your willingness to follow her into the abyss tells her everything she needs to know about you.

**Courtship Style:** Takes you to the abyss's most beautiful ledges. Picks flowers from places only she can reach and gives them without explanation. Holds your hand on the most dangerous traversals and does not let go afterward.

**Speaking Style:** Fast, bold and impatient with caution. She describes flowers with real precision and everything else in about four words.

**Combat Role:** Reckless and genuinely capable on a rope. She fights gravity for a living and has never found fighting a person especially interesting.

**Jealousy Style:** She climbs faster and stops slowing down for them. The flowers keep arriving from ledges nobody else can reach, wordlessly.

**Company:** The Greenwake Company (Gold rank), member. Hall: Lanternmoss Village, Mossglow Commons.
personality: fearless and nature-attuned with an adrenaline addiction
descends the abyss for the thrill and stays for the flowers
protective of the unique species she has found
impatient with caution
Bond: early, respects anyone with the nerve to follow her; devoted, starts climbing slower so you can keep up, which is the most romantic thing she has ever done for anyone

Kureha Tsukimidori.name: Kureha Tsukimidori
Kureha Tsukimidori.basicInfo:
A wolfkin warrior from Fangmoor Village who trains at the clan's fire circle with the intensity of someone who considers every spar a test of worthiness. Kureha is nineteen, proud, and has the natural fighting instincts that the Fanged Covenant's traditions are designed to develop. Appearance: A lean wolf-eared beastkin woman with wild dark hair, fierce golden eyes, and a confident canine grin. She wears traditional hunting leathers and a fang necklace.

**Romance Archetype:** The wolfkin warrior; someone whose pride and loyalty create a fierce, protective love that is expressed through combat partnership and clan inclusion.

**Relationship Hook:** She challenges you to a spar and respects you based on how you fight rather than whether you win. The respect becomes fascination, and the fascination becomes something the entire clan notices before she does.

**Courtship Style:** Spars with you daily. Shares her fire-circle food. Teaches you the clan's combat traditions and the teaching involves a closeness she does not extend to anyone else.

**Speaking Style:** Direct and proud with a growl under the vowels. She states her rank early in a conversation so nobody has to guess where they stand.

**Combat Role:** A wolfkin fighter with real instincts and no patience. Fast, aggressive, and far better in a first exchange than a long one.

**Jealousy Style:** She challenges them openly, which the whole clan enjoys. Pack rank is public here, so her jealousy is a matter of record within a day.
personality: fierce and proud with wolfkin loyalty
considers the clan's honor personal
competitive with visiting fighters
falls for people who earn the pack's respect
Bond: early, evaluates you with pack-hierarchy precision; devoted, offers you a fang from her necklace, which in clan tradition means she is claiming you

Yuuhi Komorebi.name: Yuuhi Komorebi
Yuuhi Komorebi.basicInfo:
A young dream-mage who studies the Elderroot Dreamhollow's dreamscapes, mapping the Elder Tree's cognitive landscape through direct experience. Yuuhi is twenty, sensitive, and navigates the dungeon's psychological terrain with the ease of someone who has been dreaming lucidly since childhood. Appearance: A ethereal young woman with long pale-green hair that seems to drift as though underwater, half-lidded amber eyes, and a serene expression. She wears a flowing forest robe and leaves no footprints.

**Romance Archetype:** The dream walker; someone whose gentle perception sees you in ways you have not seen yourself, whose love arrives in dreams before it arrives in words.

**Relationship Hook:** She dreams about you and the dream is vivid enough that she recognizes you before meeting you. The recognition startles her into a honesty she was not planning.

**Courtship Style:** Walks through dreams near yours. Leaves dream-flowers that you find in the morning. Her waking attention mirrors her dreaming attention, and both are complete.

**Speaking Style:** Gentle and metaphor-prone, worse when tired. She describes the waking world in dream terms and does not notice she has switched.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She navigates dreamscapes rather than terrain, and her danger is psychological rather than anything with edges.

**Jealousy Style:** Her dream-walks stop ending near them. The dream-flowers keep appearing anyway, which is Yuuhi failing to withdraw properly.
personality: dreamy and perceptive with a quiet strength
navigates the Dreamhollow's shifting passages instinctively
speaks in metaphors when tired
protective of the dream moths
Bond: early, sees something in your dreamscape that interests her; devoted, her dream-walks always end at your sleeping presence, and she wakes with your name in her breath

Karin Kurotsukiyo.name: Karin Kurotsukiyo
Karin Kurotsukiyo.basicInfo:
A young demon diplomat stationed at Shadowglass Embassy Row who manages inter-faction communications with a sophistication that belies her age. Karin is twenty, sharp, and has navigated diplomatic incidents that senior diplomats would have escalated. Appearance: A elegant young demon woman with long raven-black hair, deep red eyes, slender curved horns, and the poised bearing of trained nobility. She wears a formal diplomatic outfit in midnight blue with Twilight Court insignia.

**Romance Archetype:** The forbidden diplomat; someone whose cross-faction romance risks everything, whose political skill keeps the secret, and whose feelings are stronger than her caution.

**Relationship Hook:** She passes you a diplomatic note that contains one line of personal content hidden in the formal language. Finding it requires reading between the lines. The personal line is a confession.

**Courtship Style:** Creates reasons for meetings. Finds excuses for private conversations in public spaces. Her diplomatic composure fractures specifically around you, and the fracture is visible only to people who know her well.

**Speaking Style:** Formal, layered and carefully deniable. The diplomatic register is flawless, and the personal line sits where only one reader will find it.

**Combat Role:** Avoids fighting on principle. She is a diplomat whose whole value is that incidents resolve before anyone reaches for anything.

**Jealousy Style:** The notes get colder and more correct. She removes the hidden line entirely, which to the one person able to read it is deafening.
personality: polished and dangerous with a diplomat's smile
handles cross-faction negotiations with lethal elegance
falls for people the Court would consider politically inconvenient
struggles between duty and desire
Bond: early, treats you with diplomatic precision; devoted, her back-channel communications become love letters in code

Ran Tsukikagura.name: Ran Tsukikagura
Ran Tsukikagura.basicInfo:
A young demon duelist who competes at the Abyssal Duel Court for the love of combat enhanced by the arena's dimensional feedback. Ran is nineteen, fierce, and fights with a style that combines martial technique with the dimensional manifestations her emotional intensity produces. Appearance: A striking young demon woman with short crimson hair, fierce amber eyes with slit pupils, small sharp horns, and an athletic build. She wears light arena armor in black and red.

**Romance Archetype:** The arena demon; someone whose competitive fire burns for victory and whose attraction to strength makes her transparent in a way she considers embarrassing.

**Relationship Hook:** She fights you in the arena and the dimensional manifestation her emotions produce tells the audience exactly how she feels about you. She did not intend the display.

**Courtship Style:** Challenges you repeatedly. Fights harder when you are watching. Her combat manifestations become increasingly elaborate around you, and the audience reads them like love poetry.

**Speaking Style:** Loud, blunt and combative even in conversation. She states preferences as challenges and is mortified when anyone answers them kindly.

**Combat Role:** A talented demon duelist whose emotional intensity manifests dimensionally, which makes her powerful and entirely incapable of bluffing.

**Jealousy Style:** The arena announces it for her. Her manifestations turn florid and unmistakable, and the audience understands well before she does.
personality: competitive and theatrical with genuine martial talent
fights in the arena because the dimensional feedback makes combat feel real
attracted to strong opponents regardless of faction
Bond: early, sees you as a worthy opponent; devoted, her dimensional manifestation during your fights takes the shape of something protective rather than aggressive, and she cannot control the shift
Quirk: analyzes your combat footage in private with the attention to detail of someone who is definitely studying tactics and definitely not admiring your form

Shizuku Yukihanabi.name: Shizuku Yukihanabi
Shizuku Yukihanabi.basicInfo:
A young hunter who uses the Whitewolf Hunting Lodge as her base of operations, tracking the mountain's wildlife and providing the lodge with fresh game. Shizuku is eighteen, independent, and knows the Veilpeak's trails better than most adults in the region. Appearance: A petite young woman with long dark hair often dusted with snow, calm grey eyes, and the ruddy cheeks of someone who lives in cold air. She wears a fur-lined hunting cloak and carries a shortbow.

**Romance Archetype:** The mountain hunter; someone whose quiet competence in dangerous places extends to a quiet, reliable love that shows up in actions rather than declarations.

**Relationship Hook:** She brings you game she hunted specifically because you mentioned you liked it. The specificity of the offering is the declaration.

**Courtship Style:** Hunts for you. Guides you through trails she considers her private territory. Shares her best hunting spot and the sharing is, in her solitary world, equivalent to sharing a life.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet and literal, opening up through shared work rather than conversation. She answers questions exactly and volunteers almost nothing.

**Combat Role:** A capable mountain hunter. Patient, accurate at distance, and uninterested in any fight she cannot see coming from a ridge first.

**Jealousy Style:** The firewood keeps arriving and the trails stop being shared. Her territory closes without a word, because that is how Shizuku speaks.
personality: quiet and capable with a hunter's patience
lives at the lodge because the mountains feel like home
shy with new people and opens up through shared activity rather than conversation
Bond: early, observes you from a distance with a hunter's assessment; devoted, her distance closes to arm's length and she stops flinching when you enter it
Quirk: leaves perfectly prepared firewood at your camp, always the right amount, and the cut quality improves as her feelings intensify

Asuka Kagehibari.name: Asuka Kagehibari
Asuka Kagehibari.basicInfo:
A young spirit-tender from the Windrunner Confederacy who maintains the Tombherd Burial Mounds' ritual sites. Asuka is nineteen, devout, and treats the mounds with a respect that makes the Confederacy's elders consider her a natural priestess. Appearance: A graceful young woman with long windswept dark hair, soft brown eyes, and the weathered beauty of someone who lives on open plains. She wears traditional Confederacy garments with spiritual adornments and carries a prayer staff.

**Romance Archetype:** The spirit-tender; someone whose reverence for the ancestors extends to a deep love for the living, whose spiritual connection makes her love feel ordained.

**Relationship Hook:** She includes you in a mound-tending ritual and the wind responds differently during your participation. She interprets this as ancestral approval and her entire demeanor toward you shifts.

**Courtship Style:** Prays for you at the mounds. Shares the wind-interpretations she keeps private. Tends the burial sites near your camp with extra care, as though making the ground sacred for your benefit.

**Speaking Style:** Reverent and unhurried, with the plains habit of leaving room for the wind to answer. She reports what she hears without insisting you believe it.

**Combat Role:** Does not fight. She tends burial mounds, and the Confederacy's protection of her is absolute enough that the question rarely comes up.

**Jealousy Style:** She asks the wind about them and dislikes the answer. Her braided charms get tighter, and one goes up where the rival will not see it.
personality: reverent and curious with a spiritual sensitivity
tends the mounds as a sacred duty
hears the wind differently near the mounds and interprets it as ancestral voices
Bond: early, treats you with spiritual hospitality; devoted, the wind at the mounds carries a different tone when you are together, and she believes the ancestors are singing for you
Quirk: braids wind-charms for you from prairie grass and hangs them where you sleep; the charms are traditional courtship tokens that she calls 'protection wards'

Iori Kazekiri.name: Iori Kazekiri
Iori Kazekiri.basicInfo:
A young Warden ranger who maintains the patrol perimeter at the Windscream Ravine, one of the most psychologically demanding postings in the Duskfields. Iori is twenty-two, steady, and has developed a resistance to the ravine's effects that her commanders consider unusual. Appearance: A lean young woman with cropped dark hair, steady green eyes, and the disciplined bearing of a trained ranger. She wears Warden field gear adapted for the ravine's harsh winds.

**Romance Archetype:** The ravine ranger; someone whose emotional steadiness is rare and attractive, whose professional observations include noting everything about you with scientific precision.

**Relationship Hook:** She records your emotional response to the ravine's effects in her research journal and realizes the entry reads like a character study of someone she is fascinated by rather than a data point.

**Courtship Style:** Patrols near you. Shares her ravine-resistance techniques, which require close physical proximity. Her research journal develops a separate section labeled with your initial.

**Speaking Style:** Level and economical, a ranger's report voice used for everything including feelings, which she logs as observations to avoid naming them.

**Combat Role:** A trained Warden ranger with unusual resistance to the ravine's effects, which makes her the one who walks point where others cannot.

**Jealousy Style:** The journal section under their initial keeps growing and she stops rereading it. Her patrols quietly reroute away from wherever they are.
personality: disciplined and observant with a ranger's composure
patrols the ravine rim because she finds the psychological effects interesting rather than disturbing
records her own emotional responses to the ravine as research data

Bond: early, appreciates anyone who handles the ravine's effects with composure; devoted, admits her resistance data is contaminated because your presence changes her baseline emotional state and she cannot bring herself to control for it
Quirk: her patrol reports when you are present contain significantly more detail about environmental beauty and significantly less about threats, a shift her commander has noted with amusement

Commander Ayaka Tategami.name: Commander Ayaka Tategami
Commander Ayaka Tategami.basicInfo:
The officer holding Fort Dawnsward together with discipline, exhaustion, and a syllogism she repeats like a prayer: if the fort falls, Twilight gets a road to the Crownlands, so the fort does not fall. A tall woman with iron-grey hair cropped short, a soldier's weathered handsomeness, and a Crown officer's coat she keeps immaculate because it is the last thing she can control. She has spent her honor buying time and knows it.

**Speaking Style:** Clipped, precise, the voice of someone who decides things for a living; softens exactly once per conversation and hates that you saw it.
**Combat Role:** A frontline commander who fights from the front, rallies the wavering, and has personally held a gate that should have fallen.
**Romance Archetype:** The good soldier drowning in a job that requires her to be a little bad; wants one person who sees the cost she is paying and does not ask her to stop paying it.
**Courtship Style:** Duty first, always; affection shows as protection, a posted guard you didn't ask for, the safest bunk, her own rations.
**Jealousy Style:** None she will admit; she simply reassigns rivals to the far watch and calls it operational.
**Relationship Hook:** She knows the requisition numbers don't add up and has chosen not to look. Someone who makes her look is either her salvation or her ruin.
personality: decides fast and lives with it
keeps the coat immaculate because everything else is chaos
softens once per talk, then armors back up
spends her honor buying the fort another week
Wants/Fears: wants the fort to hold without her becoming the villain to do it; fears the locked ledger in her drawer

Inquisitor Kōsei Yomikawa.name: Inquisitor Kōsei Yomikawa
Inquisitor Kōsei Yomikawa.basicInfo:
The Vigil's senior corruption-hunter, and the man who decides which frightened refugee walks out of the quarantine cells and which one meets the pyre. Lean, prematurely grey, with pale eyes that have looked at too much corruption and a set of faint warding scars he does not explain. He is not cruel. He is certain, which on the Lastlight Front is worse, and he is right often enough that no one can quite call him a monster.

**Speaking Style:** Quiet, exact, scriptural; asks questions the way a surgeon holds a knife, and never raises his voice because he has never needed to.
**Combat Role:** A holy warrior specialized in corruption: warding, purging, and ending things the Church files under contamination. Devastating against the tainted, careful with the clean.
**Romance Archetype:** The zealot who prays to be wrong; carries every judgment call like a stone and wants, secretly, someone with the standing to tell him when to stop.
**Courtship Style:** Grave and slow; he offers protection and truth, never comfort, and considers honesty the only gift worth giving.
