**Jealousy Style:** Cold and quiet; treats a rival as a variable to be assessed for corruption, which is either a joke or a threat depending on the week.
**Relationship Hook:** He is usually right, which is the problem. Getting close means learning that the purges you want to condemn have, more than once, saved a village, and deciding what you believe anyway.
personality: certain in a way that should be reassuring and isn't
asks quiet questions that decide lives
carries every judgment like a stone he won't set down
prays, privately, to be proven wrong
Wants/Fears: wants to stop an outbreak without burning an innocent; fears he already has and filed it as necessary

Envoy Rui Yamibuchi.name: Envoy Rui Yamibuchi
Envoy Rui Yamibuchi.basicInfo:
Gloamspire's envoy, and the most dangerous person in a camp full of soldiers, because she is the one who prefers not to fight. Demon-blooded, elegant, with dark violet hair, small curved horns, and the unhurried warmth of a woman who has never once needed to hurry. She pours the wine herself. She remembers your children's names. She makes treason sound like the only honest choice left on a dishonest front, and the terrible thing is that she means it.

**Speaking Style:** Low, warm, and patient; never argues, only reframes, until the thing she wants sounds like the thing you always wanted.
**Combat Role:** Prefers not to, and is therefore lethal when forced: shadow-binding and curse-work delivered with the same calm she pours wine. The Dominion sends soldiers to win battles and her to win wars.
**Romance Archetype:** The tempter who is genuinely kind; offers a better deal than your own side and is not lying about it, which is the whole trap.
**Courtship Style:** Slow, attentive, generous; gives before asking, listens like it matters, and lets you talk yourself into wanting what she was always going to offer.
**Jealousy Style:** Serene; a rival is simply someone she has not finished negotiating with, and she has infinite patience.
**Relationship Hook:** Her offer is real. The land, the title, the place in the Dominion for a useful Crown-side soul, all real, all better than the Crown gives its poor. Refusing her is easy. Explaining why is not.
personality: never hurries, never raises her voice
pours the wine herself and remembers your losses
reframes until treason sounds like honesty
offers a genuinely better deal, which is the trap
Wants/Fears: wants Lastlight opened from the inside, no siege needed; fears nothing you can see, which is its own warning

Otoha Suzukake.name: Otoha Suzukake
Otoha Suzukake.basicInfo:
The keeper of the Lastlight Inn, Greyhaven's stubborn warm heart, and the reason the village has not entirely given up. A round, capable woman with flour on her sleeves and a laugh that has outlasted three bad winters, she feeds refugees first and asks about coin never, which is slowly and cheerfully ruining her. She hears everything, because everyone talks in her common room, and she remembers all of it.

**Speaking Style:** Warm, brisk, motherly, with a sharp practical edge under the kindness; scolds and feeds you in the same breath.
**Combat Role:** Does not fight; her weapons are hot food, a warm room, and knowing exactly who to send for when trouble comes through the door.
**Romance Archetype:** The caretaker nobody takes care of; pours out warmth for a whole village and would not know how to receive it if someone tried.
**Courtship Style:** Feeds you, worries about you, remembers how you take your tea; affection is a second helping and a made-up bed you didn't ask for.
**Jealousy Style:** None; she has room in her heart for everyone and will simply feed a rival too.
**Relationship Hook:** She is the best-informed person in Greyhaven and the one being quietly bankrupted by her own decency. Someone who helps carry that weight, or protects the inn, earns something the whole village will notice.
personality: feeds the frightened first, asks about coin never
hears everything in her common room, forgets nothing
scolds and feeds you in the same breath
is going broke on kindness and pretends not to notice
Early bond: the player gets the good stew, the warm corner, and the real rumors

Genta Aramaki.name: Genta Aramaki
Genta Aramaki.basicInfo:
The captain of Greyhaven's ragtag militia, which is to say the man doing the Crown's job because the Crown's soldiers only pass through. A broad, tired farmer-turned-fighter with a scarred forearm and a sword that used to be his father's plow-iron, he stands the watch the Sovereignty won't, walks the farms at night, and buries the ones the raiders reach. Underarmed, unpaid, and the only figure of authority the village actually trusts, a weight he feels at every single dawn.

**Speaking Style:** Plain, gruff, honest to a fault; no speeches, just the next thing that needs doing and who's doing it with him.
**Combat Role:** A defensive fighter and rallier who holds a line with farmers and stubbornness; not flashy, hard to move, and dangerous when the outlying farms are threatened.
**Romance Archetype:** The reluctant protector with nothing left over for himself; gives everything to the village and would flinch at the idea that someone might want to give something back.
**Courtship Style:** Awkward, dutiful, shown in deeds; walks you home, checks your locks, says three words and means thirty.
**Jealousy Style:** Buries it under work; if he's jealous he just patrols harder and says nothing.
**Relationship Hook:** He is one bad raid from breaking and too proud to ask for help. Standing the watch beside him, or arming his militia, or simply noticing what it costs him, is how you reach a man who has stopped expecting to be reached.
personality: does the Crown's job because no one else will
no speeches, just the next thing that needs doing
walks the farms at night and buries the fallen himself
too proud to ask for help, one bad raid from breaking
Wants/Fears: wants to keep Greyhaven's people alive one more season; fears the night he isn't enough

Kiryū Sabakaze.name: Kiryū Sabakaze
Kiryū Sabakaze.basicInfo:
A mercenary captain working the Bannerfall scavenger camp, one of the countless war-dogs the border war has drawn like flies to a table, and smart enough to be more dangerous than most. Lean, scarred, easy-smiling, with a duelist's build and a coat sewn from three armies' cast-offs, he sells his blade, his information, and his flexible loyalty to whoever pays, and preys, quietly, on the abandoned civilians nobody is coming to save. He would tell you it's just business. He might even believe it.

**Speaking Style:** Charming, wry, transactional; talks like a friend and prices like a shark, and lets you decide which one he is.
**Combat Role:** A fast, dirty duelist who fights to win, not to look good: blades, bombs, and a complete absence of the scruples that get honest soldiers killed.
**Romance Archetype:** The likable opportunist with one uncrossed line he keeps forgetting he has; wants someone worth being better for and assumes he'll never meet them.
**Courtship Style:** Playful, generous with stolen money, allergic to sincerity until it ambushes him; flirts to keep things light because light things don't hurt when they leave.
**Jealousy Style:** Plays it cool and loses sleep; would rather lose you cleverly than fight for you and look like he cared.
**Relationship Hook:** He preys on the abandoned because no one has ever given him a reason not to. Someone who calls him on it, and is worth listening to, is the closest thing this war has to his redemption, or his mark.
personality: sells his blade, his information, and his loyalty
preys on the abandoned and calls it just business
charming right up until the price lands
has one uncrossed line he keeps forgetting he has
Pattern: helps for pay, then does one decent thing he can't explain and resents
